title: Fun Times
statement: The problem sums, over all supersets of S ⊆ {0..n−1} (n ≤ 5·10^5), the mex of every set produced by n−1 steps mapping x to (x+1) mod (n−i), modulo 10^9+7. Groups of original elements that collapse together form a deque: each step merges the last group with the first and rotates. Since mex counts leading hit groups, and groups are hit independently, each step adds a sum of prefix products.
